Subject: StudioEdge pilot — procurement path & MAP (PO vs Marketplace)

Hi Olivia — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment on the commercial path and procurement milestones. I copied Ben (sales ops), Monica (CS) and Laura (commercial lead) to help pull the paperwork and timelines together.

Call highlights
- StudioEdge is scoped for a 3-month pilot (~$65k run rate) to validate search-augmentation flows.
- Primary concern: procurement instrument (PO vs credit card vs marketplace). Finance prefers PO for commitments > $50k; marketplace preferred for smaller pilots.
- Security ask: SOC 2 report and data-retention notes required by the security team.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) & suggested dates
1) Legal review (MSA + minimal redlines) — target complete by Mon Jun 21
2) Security review (SOC2 + network controls) — target signoff by Thu Jun 24
3) Finance / procurement acceptance & PO issuance — target by Tue Jun 30
4) Kickoff & pilot start — Wed Jul 1

Attachments I've uploaded for your convenience: SoW-draft-v1.pdf (pilot scope + pricing) and a short Procurement-timeline.xlsx with the milestones above.

Questions / asks for you
- Can you confirm whether your procurement team will issue a PO or would you prefer to run the pilot through the AWS Marketplace?
- Please confirm primary procurement contact (cc'd email or procurement@studioedge.com) and any internal deadlines we should be aware of.
- Does StudioEdge need a SOC 2 attestation copy? If yes we'll pass the link to the security package.

Next suggested step: 30-min sync with procurement + legal on Thurs Jun 10 or Fri Jun 11. I can coordinate — what works best for your team?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus — good summary and appreciate the MAP. Quick answers below and a note from procurement attached.

- StudioEdge is interested in marketplace for ease, but finance policy requires a PO for any commitment above $50k. Since the pilot sits at ~ $65k, we'll need to go PO route.
- I've cc'd procurement@studioedge.com — they will own the PO issuance. They'll want a completed SoW + MSA and our PO template attached.
- Security: yes, please send SOC 2 (Type II) and a short description of data retention and subprocessor list. The security team will run the review in parallel to legal.
- Revised internal target: legal done by Fri Jun 18 (they are faster this week) and procurement aiming to issue PO by Mon Jun 28.

I attached our PO template and procurement intake form. For the Thu Jun 10 slot — we can do 10:00am PT. I'll add calendar invite.
